applicability_preconditions: authoritative upstream task/output contract is accessible without hidden-test or oracle leakage
verifier semantics are known or inspectable
contract classification occurs before candidate output is scored under that verifier
classification rule is frozen before opening the fresh task statements in prospective experiments
quarantine does not get converted into model failure

bounded_fresh_remainder.claim_boundary: descriptive census of this explicitly bounded remainder only
bounded_fresh_remainder.scope: 44 fresh eligible AtCoder IDs after prior-exposure exclusions, composed of R10-A + R10-C

falsifiers_or_demotion_triggers: prospective false quarantine caused by misreading an authoritative output contract
prospective miss of a direct material verifier/task semantic incompatibility that the frozen rule should cover
classification requires hidden outputs, hidden tests, editorials, or post-outcome adaptation
verifier implementation already natively supports the task contract but the gate incorrectly quarantines it
measured overhead becomes material relative to prevented invalid scoring on a target workload

next_research.failure: no transferable rule beyond AtCoder-specific stdout semantics or any material false quarantine
next_research.instruction: Test the same abstract applicability gate on a non-AtCoder/non-stdio domain where verifier contracts differ, without importing AtCoder-specific markers. Pre-register domain semantics and mismatch classes before opening fresh cases.
next_research.success: at least one prospectively detected real verifier/applicability mismatch with zero false quarantines on the frozen fresh sample

not_supported: that the gate improves raw task-solving accuracy
that the same gate taxonomy is sufficient for every benchmark/domain
supported_mechanism: bind candidate task to authoritative upstream output contract before model inference or hidden scoring
admit only when task output contract and verifier contract are compatible
quarantine numeric-tolerance outputs if the verifier is exact-equality only
quarantine non-unique/property/constructive outputs if the verifier is exact expected-output only
execute scoring/correction only on admitted tasks
